title: New BloxStike Update! [Regularly Updated]
features:
Join our community for updates: https://discord.gg/ufhPgvYV9y

For other previews/full gameplays, check out these videos:

https://youtu.be/EMm78BLKdwI
https://youtu.be/Pq-HX60QnBM

Thank you! Please, if you find any bugs, report it via discord

Combat:
- Camera Aimbot with smoothness control and adjustable FOV circle
- Silent Aim with configurable hitchance (no camera snapping)
- Aim key binding, target part selection, and target priority mode
- Wall Check and Auto-Wall penetration
- Movement Prediction
- Trigger Bot — auto-fires when crosshair is on target, with reaction delay humanizer and max distance cap
- Trigger Bot key binding and team check
- Hitbox Expander with size slider
- Spinbot with speed control
- Anti-Aim
- Humanizer (Legit Mode) with keybind toggle
- Team Check for aimbot

Ragebot Tab:
- Ragebot with Semi and Full modes
- Rage target part selection
- Insta-Kill All with keybind toggle
- Selected Player Insta-Kill — pick specific enemies to auto-kill

ESP & Bypass:

- Master ESP toggle with team check
- 2D Bounding Boxes (color-coded by team)
- Enemy Health Bar with gradient indicator
- Player Names and Distance labels
- Head Dot
- Full R15 Skeleton
- 3D Glow Highlight Chams
- Bullet Impact Tracers with color and intensity control
- Target Tracers with origin selection
- Character Tracers with color control
- Off-Screen Enemy Arrows (2D indicators)
- Body Glow with style options
- Molotov Zone ESP with color control
- Smoke Zone ESP with color control
- Anti-Flash (ignore flashbangs)
- Anti-Smoke (see and shoot through smokes)

Hit Feedback:
- Custom Hitmarker with style, color, size, gap, thickness, duration, and outline controls
- Hit Sound with preset selector and custom Sound ID support
- Volume control
- Valorant Kill Announcer with volume control
- Environment Tab
- Atmosphere controls: density, haze, glare
- Color Adjustments: saturation and contrast
- Custom Sky and Weather presets
- Brightness, ambient color, and outdoor color controls
- Environment (dark gothic world overhaul)
- Clouds, Fog, Crimson Lighting, and Dark Sky variants

Weapons & Camera:
- Custom sniper crosshair with gap, length, thickness, outline, and color controls
- Remove black sniper scope border
- No Recoil
- No Spread
- Rapid Fire
- Instant Reload
- Auto-Buy Weapon each round with weapon selector
- Bunny Hop
- Third Person POV with distance and height offset sliders
- Widened Arms and Viewmodel (CS2-style FOV)

Skin Changer:
- Weapon Skin Changer with per-weapon dropdown selectors
- Shuffle button to randomize all skins
- Custom Knife Viewmodel with knife model selector
- Knife Skins
- Glove Changer with model selector
- CT Weapon Skins and T Weapon Skins
- Glow/Transparent White mode for weapons, knife, arms, gloves, sleeves, and full character body

Settings
- Custom Config Manager — save, load, delete, and refresh named configs
- Spectator HUD Panel (shows who is watching you)
- Anti-Detect HUD Panel
- Anonymous Mode
- Anti-Mod / Staff Detection with configurable action and rank threshold
- Multiple UI Themes
- Script ejection and lifecycle controls

Advanced Active Engine
- Ultimate Anti-Kick 
- Robust Anti-Detect V2 engine running in the background.
- Safe Drawing API — works on executors without native Drawing support (Solara, Xeno, mobile)
- Universal executor compatibility (Solara, Xeno, Delta, Wave, Macsploit, and more)
- Clean re-execution teardown — no double listeners or leaked loops on re-inject
